name: First five

sprites.name: Delta Charizard
sprites.note: Back only; the front is as it was. Face: turned about 15 degrees clockwise, so the muzzle is level, no longer lifted. Breathing: the back now breathes exactly as the front does. Before, it had no hold at the bottom of each breath, skipped the fifth breath, moved the body, arms and wings by different amounts, and one thigh twitched by a pixel. Now everything above the legs goes down 3 pixels together, holds, and comes up, five times before the roar, and the thighs stay still. Also moved the near wing bone clear of the head, where a sliver of light showed between them.

note: Thirteenth look. Delta Charizard's back: the face is turned down level and the breathing is steady. The front is unchanged.
